new_slugs.name: Union of Burma (Myanmar)
new_slugs.why: Cliopatria row 'Burma' (10 shapes, 1820-1989) is two states: burma_1820-1885 is the Konbaung kingdom, burma_1948-1989 reuses the 1819 Konbaung outline for post-independence Myanmar (flagged adjust to {country: Myanmar}); the 'Union of Myanmar' row (1990-2024, se-04) is the same state under a new name and shares Q836. Wikidata Q836 sits on union-of-burma, not on burma (burma carries null). The brief's one-dossier-under-the-earlier-slug rule would have fused a colonial-era kingdom with the modern republic, so the dossier was split and carries both Names in cliopatria_names.

problems: Split decision on the shared Q836 pair: the brief says one dossier under the earlier slug if burma and union-of-myanmar are one state. They are not (burma_1820-1885 is the Konbaung kingdom; the 1948-1989 shapes reuse the 1819 Konbaung outline for the modern republic). Wrote burma (1820-1885, wikidata null) and a new union-of-burma (1948-2024, Q836, cliopatria_names Burma + Union of Myanmar). The se-04 batch owns the Union of Myanmar row and should either drop it or point at union-of-burma, otherwise two dossiers cover 1990-2024.
Cliopatria 'Cambodia' row (1700-1802) is the Mekong delta, not Cambodia proper; counterpart is post-angkor-cambodia, not cambodia.

union-of-burma shows 8 'no verdict' validator warnings (burma_1820-1859 are reviewed in burma) and burma shows 2 (burma_1948, burma_1987 are reviewed in union-of-burma). All 10 are expected from the split; the validator checks each dossier against the whole Cliopatria row.
konbaung-dynasty (other se-01 part) ends 1819, burma starts 1820: continuous, no overlap.

Page budget overshoot: rattanakosin-kingdom opened 11 pages against 9 (Thonburi Kingdom and Siamese-Vietnamese War 1833-1834 were added to date the 1782 founding and the Khôi-rebellion intervention); burma plus union-of-burma used 6 pages against 5 (Union of Burma and Myanmar pages for the post-1948 shapes).

WebFetch retries: three Siamese-Vietnamese war URLs failed with URL_NOT_FOUND (lowercase 'war', wrong years 1831-1834, unencoded en dash) before the correct titles loaded; all pages eventually opened, so pages_failed is empty.
Cession dates in Cliopatria lag the pages by 1-2 years (1893, 1904, 1907, Cochinchina 1859 vs 1862/1867); events follow the page date and the keyframe verdicts say adjust.

Quote policy: WebFetch returns paraphrased page text, so notes use the whitelist post-processor and every dossier notes field carries the quote-policy sentence; no direct quotes are asserted beyond the whitelist.
